title: Gather items into a crate
summary: Bring a crate onto a lift, feed five workpieces into it one at a time and send it away full.
scope: Tests give deterministic native POSIX host evidence on a simulated plant scene; they are not physical, hardware, HIL, or certification evidence.
objectives: Combine a count, a lift and a crate in one sequence of steps.
Move the lift only with its surface stopped, and feed the next workpiece only after the last one has landed.

stages.title: Objective
stages.body: In src/LiftStacking.st, keep a Step variable for the sequence and a Parts count: bring the crate onto the lift, raise it, feed five workpieces, lower it and send the crate out.
stages.checkpoint: Each step turns on only the outputs it needs, so Step tells you what the station does.

stages.title: Predict
stages.body: Before running, follow the crate and the workpieces: the crate stops on the lift when CrateEye sees it; at level 2 the feeder puts down one workpiece at a time, and each needs about two seconds to land before the next one.
stages.checkpoint: Up and RunLift are never TRUE together, Parts reaches five, and Green lights after OutEye sees the crate leave.

stages.title: Edit
stages.body: Correct this starter omission, save it, then run: The starter drives no output, so nothing moves; sequence the station: emit a crate, raise the lift, feed and count five workpieces one at a time, lower the lift and send the crate out, lighting Green when OutEye sees it.
stages.checkpoint: The visible scenario must pass with saved host evidence.

stages.title: Run
stages.body: Press Check. ZPLC runs your saved program against the scenario of this lesson, with the plant answering your outputs, and lists every assertion that failed. To watch the plant move, press Run (F5) and open the 3D view.
stages.checkpoint: The required scenario is named lift-stacking and contains {{assertions}} assertions.

stages.title: Observe
stages.body: Watch the workpieces land in the crate in the 3D view and read loaded:crate:0 in the facts text.
stages.checkpoint: The crate carries its workpieces while the lift travels, and none lands outside it.

stages.title: Reflect
stages.body: The loaded:crate:0 fact is TRUE once at least one workpiece rests inside the crate, and the delivered fact proves the crate reached its bin.
stages.checkpoint: The grade cannot count the workpieces: it does not tell four from five, because an expectation has no numeric comparison; read the count in the facts. It does not establish physical lift speed, hardware timing, HIL, or certification.

hints.text: Count a workpiece when CountEye ends (an F_TRIG), not when it starts, and wait for the landing before feeding the next one.
Use a TON for the landing wait; between workpieces run the platform surface for a short moment so the workpieces do not pile on one spot.

faultCases: The starter drives no output, so nothing moves; sequence the station: emit a crate, raise the lift, feed and count five workpieces one at a time, lower the lift and send the crate out, lighting Green when OutEye sees it.
